ingredients.name: Spinach, thawed and drained
ingredients.key: Spinach, thawed and drained · 250 g usable per pack

prep: Ask an adult to preheat the oven and prepare the pepper; squeeze excess water from the thawed spinach.
Cover the flatbreads with the measured passata, vegetables and torn mozzarella.
An adult bakes two flatbreads per batch until hot throughout and the cheese has melted.
Let the pizzas cool slightly before an adult cuts them for serving.
recipeCard.allergens: Wheat/gluten in flatbreads and milk in mozzarella; check flatbread labels for other ingredients.
recipeCard.safety: Wash hands and produce. An adult must handle sharp knives, hot pans, boiling water, the oven and any blender. Timings are estimates: an adult checks the food is properly cooked.
recipeCard.allergenNote: Check every ingredient and topping label with an adult, including possible cross-contact. These notes do not guarantee allergy safety.
